title: Contracts.
bodyText: The public guardian may make and enter into contracts, and generally do all such things as in its judgment may be necessary, proper, and expedient in accomplishing its duties.
bodyHtml: [§551A-9]  Contracts.  The public guardian may make and enter into contracts, and generally do all such things as in its judgment may be necessary, proper, and expedient in accomplishing its duties. [L 1984, c 223, pt of §1]
